utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive list in order, Bo. Tell me what’s needed first and I’ll put it on the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Start with the leaky sink and the front gate.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s moving along, but I’m still catching up on the details. What’s the latest you’ve heard?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Last I heard, they’ve got a solid turnout and folks are sorting donations by what needs fixing first. I’m trying to hear whether they still need hands for the afternoon shift.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Vik, what time are you heading over for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m thinking around 10, and I’ll probably swing by the school lot first to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I could use a hand with the heavier stuff, and maybe a spare extension cord if you have one.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive. I was just about to ask Pia what still needs doing and where I can help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I still need the boxes sorted and the labels checked, and I’m a bit worried about getting the donations over there on time. If you can help with loading and the drop-off list, that would take a lot off my plate.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right, the repair drive. I heard they’re still collecting tools and supplies over by the community hall, and a few folks said they’d help sort everything this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Who’s in charge of the drop-off, and what time should I bring what I’ve got?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. Just tell me what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Bo. Could you help sort the donated tools and set them out by the garage?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know when and where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik. I’ll keep an ear out for updates and pass them along if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the repair drive. I was just about to ask what still needs doing, because I’ve got a few tools and I can come by today.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help a lot. I still need the porch latch looked at and a loose step tightened, if you’ve got time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I’m lining up the first houses now. If you’ve got updates from your side, send them over and I’ll fold them in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can send mine, but I’m still waiting on two addresses and a time window for the truck.
